name: piz_fs_create
comment (MFL.exe: Registers the PIZ file system (vtable: open/close/read/seek/eof/exists)

name: piz_open_archive
comment (MFL.exe: Reads header + file table (0x80 byte entries; table buffer 0x8000 bytes = 256 files)

name: piz_open_file
comment (MFL.exe: CreateFileA unbuffered+overlapped (or stdio on non-PC platforms)

name: piz_close_archive
comment (MFL.exe: restores the previous default file system

name: piz_find_entry_size
comment (MFL.exe: stricmp scan of the table; returns entry+0x78 (size)

name: piz_fs_open
comment (MFL.exe: matches name with stricmp; hash at entry+0x7c is never read

name: game_register_native_filesystems
comment (MFL.exe: RtFS native file system for current dir + one per drive; sets the default FS

name: game_path_to_8_3_upper
comment (MFL.exe: drops drive letter; dirs and names max 8 letters; total max 0x31

name: game_content_exists_prefixed
comment (MFL.exe: tries pc/ xbox/ ps2/ gamecube/ prefixes

name: game_content_find
comment (MFL.exe: Searching piz for %s: pc/ then raw then xbox/ ps2/ gamecube/

name: weapon_find_descriptor
comment (MFL.exe: esi = weapon type id; linear search of weapon_descriptors (0x40 stride; count at weapon_descriptor_count); returns descriptor or 0

name: player_unequip_weapon
comment (MFL.exe: esi = player weapon struct; calls descriptor+0x10 then zeroes +0xA8/+0xAC; NO null check on +0xA8 (crashes if no weapon)

name: player_equip_weapon
comment (MFL.exe: cdecl (player weapon struct*; weapon type id); stores descriptor at +0xA8 and descriptor+4 result at +0xAC; NO null check on the descriptor (crashes for unknown id)

name: player_equip_weapon_by_index
comment (MFL.exe: cdecl (player index; weapon type id) -> player_equip_weapon

name: weapons_update_frame
comment (MFL.exe: per-frame weapon update for the 4 players + descriptor callbacks

name: camera_update
comment (MFL.exe: per-viewport camera: zoom (clamped to 10.0) -> tilt/height/distance; trainer patches its float operands

name: car_integrate_step
comment (MFL.exe: applies velocity and rotation to the car RwMatrix (old matrix in edi -> new in ebx) then MatrixOrthoNormalize

name: car_wheel_contact_update
comment (MFL.exe: uses the current matrix = player_car + 0x928 + 0x40 * [player_car+0x9AC]; RpCollisionWorldForAllIntersections

name: distances_update
comment (MFL.exe: per-player horizontal distance to the leader * 0.8 -> distance_to_leader[4]

name: player_distance_warning
comment (MFL.exe: returns 1 in race mode when distance_to_leader[p] > 7.0 (trainer warning threshold patch at 0044c16b)

name: game_mode_end_check
comment (MFL.exe: switch on game_mode; contains the compare against [008c7e00]==10.0 patched by the trainer 'max distance' (008c7e00 has no static writer)

name: damage_add_clamped
comment (MFL.exe: adds to damage[] and clamps to 50.0 (operand 00423fec and immediate 00423ffa are patched by the trainer)

name: soundengine_create_race_streams
comment (MFL.exe: sets race_audio_active=1 (trainer uses it as 'game active')

name: @weapon_descriptors
comment (MFL.exe: 9 entries x 0x40: +0 type id (9 a b c 10 11 12 13 7); +4 equip(player); +0x10 unequip(player); +0x1C/+0x2C/+0x30/+0x3C per-frame callbacks

name: @player_weapon_slots
comment (MFL.exe: 4 x 0xB4; +0xA8 descriptor ptr (non-null = weapon equipped); +0xAC equip result = pointer into the weapon's state array; +0xB0 player index

name: @player_car
comment (MFL.exe: 4 x 0xD04; +0 index; +4 alive?; +0x10 controls disabled; +0x144 velocity; +0x194 wheels (4 x 0xC4); +0x928 matrix[2] (RwMatrix 0x40 each; +0x30 pos); +0x9A8 next matrix idx; +0x9AC current matrix idx; +0x9B0 direction; +0xD00 bot flag

name: @race_audio_active
comment (MFL.exe: 1 while race audio streams exist (cleared on pause/exit)

name: @float_10_0
comment (MFL.exe: shared constant (88 refs): camera zoom limit / normaliser

name: @float_7_0
comment (MFL.exe: shared constant (22 refs): distance warning threshold

name: @float_0_8
comment (MFL.exe: shared constant (40 refs): camera height factor
trainer: max distance operand (compared for equality with [008c7e00])
